name: PostgreSQL
about: PostgreSQL is an open source object-relational database system that uses and extends the SQL language.

variables.label: Data folder
variables.description: Host folder for database files, owned by UID 70.

variables.label: Superuser password
variables.description: Sets the superuser password on first initialization, changing this later does not reset it. Save it before deploying.

variables.label: Superuser name
variables.description: The superuser account created on the first run.

variables.label: Initial database
variables.description: An extra database created on the first run. Leave blank to get one named after the superuser.

variables.label: Host port
variables.description: Host port for PostgreSQL, unpublished when blank.

variables.label: Network authentication
variables.description: How connections from outside the container authenticate. Written into pg_hba.conf when the database is created and ignored on later starts. Trust lets anyone who can reach the port connect as any user with no password.

variables.label: initdb arguments
variables.description: Space-separated arguments for first initialization, including ICU locale settings.

variables.label: Init scripts folder
variables.description: Host folder of .sql, .sql.gz, and .sh files, mounted read-only at /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d. They run in name order when the database is first created and never again. Leave blank to skip. Deploy fails if the folder does not exist.

variables.label: Shared buffers (MiB)
variables.description: Memory for the PostgreSQL page cache, 128 MiB when blank, overriding postgresql.conf.

variables.label: Maximum connections
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous connections, 100 when blank, overriding postgresql.conf.

variables.label: Shared memory (MiB)
variables.description: Size of /dev/shm, where parallel queries put their shared memory segments. Containers get 64 MiB. Raise it if a query fails with the could not resize shared memory segment error.
